text.tspan: 1. If a Hard Disk is installed in the computer, remove it.
2. Remove the top cover from the computer.
3. Locate and remove the Floppy Disk Controller Chip at
location U405. Replace it with the AJAX chip part number
4. Locate and remove the PAL chip at location UA2.
5. If the main PCB is lower than a REV B, remove the main
PCB and add a jumper wire in the solder side of the board
from U7 pin 32 to UA2 pin 19. Replace the main PCB.
6. Replace the PAL that was in socket UA2 with the PAL chip
part number C301901-002 included in the upgrade kit.
7. If the TOS ROMs in the computer are lower than REV 2.06,
replace them with the REV 2.06 TOS ROMs part number
8. Locate switch S701 on the main PCB and turn segment 7
on.
9. Set the jumpers on the rear of the 1.44 megabyte floppy
drive to 1-2, 5-13, and 14-15. See Figure 1.
Top of Floppy Drive
J1 SS01 Pin #3 Removed J2
to Prevent Incorrect
Insertion
Figure 1
10. Remove the old 720KB floppy drive from the top cover
and replace it with the 1.44 megabyte floppy drive part
